name: No rugs: the staged room with the bed as its anchor, washable bedding and cushions, no canopy
notes:
Rug-free alternative (F-66): the staged arrangement (a) kept piece for piece, without the VALLABY rug and the LÖVA canopy, for a family that may skip rugs for dust and dust mites. 10 placed, 9 extras.
What replaced the rug: nothing on the floor. The play floor between the TROFAST and the desk stays bare and wipes clean, and her two SKOGSDUVA flower cushions (machine-washable at 40 °C) are her seats there. The GREJSIMOJS mat does not fit open: it is 47 1/4" square, and the free floor between the TROFAST's boxes (x 57.9) and the heater's 12" for textiles (x 100, F-33) is 42 1/8" wide, with the door's and the closet's 36" landings below it (F-31). It folds up into a toy box, but its page gives no folded size, so it is not drawn here (F-11); it is staged open in the living room's e.
F-66 moves: (1) the bed as the anchor: the MINNEN on the left wall, the GODISHUS beside its head as the bedside table and the TROFAST along its foot, her reading nook; (2) light as in a: the UPPLYST over the bed for reading and the TÖVÄDER cat night light on the GODISHUS; (3) a wall anchor at her eye level: the BLODFLÄDER two birds (canvas, no glass) on the left wall at the bed's foot, with the BESTÅ cabinet hung above the desk; (4) color off the floor in washable textiles: the BARNDRÖM flower bedding (cover and fitted sheet, machine wash at 140°F/60°C, hot enough to kill dust mites), the SMÅSPORRE insert (also 140°F/60°C) and the SKOGSDUVA cushions, with the green of the FLISAT desk and the FEJKA; (5) the FEJKA on the GODISHUS (artificial: wipe it); (6) no mat (above). The LÖVA canopy is left out: it gathers dust and washes only by hand, and the bed still reads as the reading nook with its light and the books on the TROFAST.
bed-1 MINNEN (fully extended, 77.5"), head on the top wall, long side on the left wall, flush (IKEA: under 2 1/2" or over 9" from a wall): F-34 open side clear for 24" between the dresser and the TROFAST and 41" out to the desk chair; the TROFAST runs along its foot half; F-33 bedding 71.5" from the heater face.
dresser-1 GODISHUS 3-drawer beside the bed's head as the bedside table (23 5/8" high): F-32 24" in front to the TROFAST's end, 41" to the desk chair; F-21 anchor it (IKEA: "must be securely anchored").
desk-1 FLISAT on the top wall in the window corner: F-33 right end 6" from the heater face; F-35 30" chair zone clear behind it (y 25.6 to 55.6), the chair 19.5" from the heater, not backed against a heater wall; 3 1/8" from the dresser. chair-1 SUNDVIK pulled out at the desk ("Last chance" at IKEA: buy it with the desk).
cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 47 1/4x16 1/2x15" (top, new): top wall above the desk, x 58.75-106, its right end 6" short of the heater face (F-33): closed storage hung above her reach for markers, paint, glue and rotation toys a parent hands down (F-63): solid LAPPVIKEN doors (no glass, F-21), hung on 2 BESTÅ suspension rails screwed into studs (extras), underside about 54" up. The canvas art moves off this wall to make room.
toys-1 TROFAST along the bed's open side, rot 270, x 40.5-57.9, y 40.9-77.5: its back to the bed rail, its end flush with the bed's foot, the boxes facing the play floor. F-32 54" in front of the boxes to the heater face; F-31 44.5" from the closet doors and 8.5" clear of the closet's and the door's 36" landings; F-33 54" from the heater face, with no slot beside the heater. Her books stand face out on its top, within reach of the bed. Making the bed means reaching over it at the foot.
lamp-1 UPPLYST on the left wall over the bed as her reading light, cord fastened to the wall (IKEA). nightlight-1 TÖVÄDER and plant-1 FEJKA (artificial) on the dresser. art-1 BLODFLÄDER (canvas, no glass, F-21) on the left wall at the bed's foot, at her eye level, 1.5" clear of the open door.
Maddie is 4 (F-21): every piece within her reach is under 27" or anchored (the GODISHUS carries IKEA's anchor warning at 23 5/8", so it is anchored too); no glass anywhere; no loft or bunk.
Walkways (F-30): the 36" landings in front of the door and the closet are open floor (F-31); door to room along them and up past the TROFAST's end, 44.5" below it; bed to desk 41"; bed to door around the TROFAST's end.
Extras: VIMSIG mattress and BARNDRÖM fitted sheet in the frame, SMÅSPORRE insert, BARNDRÖM cover, low pillow, SKOGSDUVA cushions x2, BENGTA panel (cut to clear the heater, F-33) on the HUGAD rod (assumed-position:window), BESTÅ suspension rails x2. Not placed: the FLISAT book display ikea-80614566 (as in a), the VALLABY rug and the LÖVA canopy (F-66, above), the GREJSIMOJS (it does not fit open, above).
Total $1,114.33: placed $742.91 + extras $371.42; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
